notes: H2 uptake measured on a Micromeritics ASAP 2020 (a static volumetric/manometric analyzer; the paper names the instrument but does not use the word 'volumetric'). Isotherms at 76 K up to 1.1 atm; Fig. 12 axes read 'Absolute Pressure (atm)' and 'H2 storage capacity (wt.%)' although the caption says 'relative pressure'. The electrochemical measurements (capacitance in 0.5 M H2SO4, Section 2.2.6) are characterization only; the hydrogen uptake is gas phase, so 'electrochemical' does not apply. Table 3 SBET values (716, 727, 600, 451 m2 g-1) are for the same FCNFs samples whose H2 uptake is reported. Text (p. 5, Section 3.3.1) says surface areas 'decreased from 775 to 476 m2 g-1', inconsistent with Table 1 (810 to 451); irrelevant to eligibility. Research article; no retraction notice; is_retracted false; no statement that the H2 data were published before.
